types.AbstractCapabilityInclude: Inclusion of one capability in another (included capability designated by “included”).
types.AbstractCapabilityRealization: Realization trace: a capability realizes a capability (or an operational capability) of the previous layer.
types.AbstractFunctionAbstractCapabilityInvolv: Participation of a function in a capability (function designated by “involved”).
types.AbstractStateRealization: Realization trace between a state or mode and the matching state or mode of the previous layer.
types.ActivityAllocation: Assignment of an operational activity to the role that carries it out.
types.BooleanPropertyValue: Property value of boolean type; other value kinds have their own type (string, integer, float, enumeration).
types.Capability: System capability: a service the system provides in a given context of use, serving one or more missions; described by the functional chains and scenarios it groups.
types.CapabilityExploitation: Link through which a mission exploits a system capability.
types.CapabilityInvolvement: Participation of an actor or of the system in a capability.
types.CapabilityRealization: Logical or physical architecture capability: expresses a system capability at that level.
types.CapabilityRealizationInvolvement: Participation of a component in a logical or physical architecture capability.
types.CapabilityRealizationPkg: Package grouping logical or physical architecture capabilities.
types.CatalogElement: Reuse catalogue element: a reusable template (REC) or a replica of it (RPL).
types.CatalogElementLink: Link from a catalogue element (REC or RPL) to a model element; in a replica, it also points to the matching link of the original REC.
types.CatalogElementPkg: Package grouping REC / RPL catalogue elements.
types.ChangeEvent: Event raised when a condition becomes true (“when” event).
types.ChoicePseudoState: Choice pseudo-state: the rest of the transition depends on the guards evaluated at that moment.
types.Collection: Data type denoting a collection (list, set) of elements of the same type.
types.CombinedFragment: Combined fragment of a scenario: groups messages under an operator (ALT, OPT, LOOP, PAR…).
types.CommunicationMean: Communication means between operational entities or actors, carrying their interactions.
types.CompliancyDefinition: Level of compliance required of a replica (RPL) with respect to its reusable template (REC).
types.CompliancyDefinitionPkg: Package grouping REC / RPL compliance definitions.
types.ComponentExchange: Exchange between two components (or actors), connecting their component ports.
types.ComponentExchangeAllocation: Allocation of a component exchange to an element of another layer.
types.ComponentExchangeFunctionalExchangeAlloc: Allocation of a functional exchange to the component exchange that carries it.
types.ComponentFunctionalAllocation: Allocation of a function to the component (or actor) that performs it.
types.ComponentPort: Component port: interaction point through which its component exchanges pass.
types.ComponentPortAllocation: Allocation of a component port to another port (for example a physical port).
types.ComponentRealization: Realization trace: a component realizes a component of the previous layer (for example a physical component realizes a logical component).
types.ConfigurationItem: EPBS configuration item: a part of the system to be bought or produced.
types.Constraint: Constraint (expression or text) set on one or more model elements.
types.ControlNode: Control node of a functional chain (AND, OR, ITERATE) that steers its flow.
types.DeepHistoryPseudoState: Deep history pseudo-state: return to the last active state, sub-states included.
types.EPBSArchitecture: EPBS layer (End-Product Breakdown Structure): breakdown of the product into configuration items.
types.Entity: Operational analysis entity; with actor='true', it is an operational actor.
types.EntityOperationalCapabilityInvolvement: Participation of an entity or actor in an operational capability.
types.EntityPkg: Package grouping operational entities and actors.
types.EnumerationPropertyLiteral: Possible value of an enumerated property type.
types.EnumerationPropertyType: Enumerated type used to type a property value.
types.EventReceiptOperation: Receipt of an event in a scenario.
types.EventSentOperation: Sending of an event in a scenario (linked to a message).
types.ExchangeCategory: Functional exchange category: groups exchanges to classify or filter them.
types.ExchangeItem: Exchange item: a set of data transmitted together during an exchange between functions, components or actors.
types.ExchangeItemAllocation: Attachment of an exchange item to an interface, with its transmission direction.
types.ExchangeItemElement: Component of an exchange item (a piece of data it carries).
types.Execution: Execution on a scenario lifeline (vertical bar of the sequence diagram).
types.ExecutionEnd: End of an execution in a scenario.
types.ExecutionEvent: Event that starts an execution in a scenario.
types.FinalState: Final state of a state machine or region.
types.FragmentEnd: Bound (start or end) of a combined fragment in a scenario.
types.FunctionInputPort: Function input port: what the function needs.
types.FunctionOutputPort: Function output port: what the function produces.
types.FunctionRealization: Realization trace: a function realizes a function of the previous layer.
types.FunctionalChain: Functional chain: a sequence of functions and functional exchanges describing a behaviour in a context of use.
types.FunctionalChainAbstractCapabilityInvolve: Participation of a functional chain in a capability.
types.FunctionalChainInvolvementFunction: Functional chain step: the function concerned is designated by “involved”.
types.FunctionalChainInvolvementLink: Functional exchange traversed by a chain, between two steps (source, target) that set the order.
types.FunctionalChainRealization: Realization trace: a functional chain realizes a chain (or an operational process) of the previous layer.
types.FunctionalChainReference: Call of a functional chain inside another one (nested chains).
types.FunctionalExchange: Functional exchange: a flow from a source function to a target function, from an output port to an input port.
types.FunctionalExchangeRealization: Realization trace: a functional exchange realizes an exchange of the previous layer.
types.Generalization: Generalization (inheritance) between two classifiers: the more specific one inherits from the more general one.
types.GenericTrace: Free traceability link between two elements, with no particular realization meaning.
types.InformationRealization: Realization trace: a class or exchange item realizes the one of the previous layer.
types.InitialPseudoState: Initial pseudo-state: entry point of a region.
types.InstanceRole: Scenario lifeline: represents a function, component, actor or entity.
types.InteractionOperand: Operand of a combined fragment (for example a branch of an ALT).
types.InteractionState: State, mode or function shown on a scenario lifeline.
types.InteractionUse: Call of another scenario within the current scenario.
types.Interface: Interface: a set of exchange items that a component port can send or receive.
types.KeyValue: Key / value pair used to store metadata or extension parameters.
types.LogicalArchitecture: Logical architecture layer: a technology-independent “white box” solution.
types.LogicalArchitectureRealization: Realization trace: the physical architecture realizes the logical architecture.
types.LogicalComponent: Logical component: a part of the system in a technology-independent white-box breakdown.
types.LogicalComponentPkg: Package grouping the logical system, its components and its actors.
types.MessageEnd: End (sending or receipt) of a message in a scenario.
types.Mission: Mission: a high-level goal the system contributes to through one or more capabilities.
types.MissionInvolvement: Participation of an actor or of the system in a mission.
types.Mode: Mode: an operating configuration that is chosen and activated for the system, an actor or a component (unlike a state, which is undergone).
types.ModelInformation: Technical information about the model (version, origin).
types.OpaqueExpression: Free expression (text, possibly in a given language), used for a condition or a computed value.
types.OperationalActivity: Operational activity: an action carried out by an operational entity or actor, without reference to the system to be designed.
types.OperationalAnalysis: Operational analysis layer: users' needs and activities, without reference to the system.
types.OperationalAnalysisRealization: Realization trace: the system analysis realizes the operational analysis.
types.OperationalCapability: Operational capability: an ability expected of operational entities or actors, described by processes and scenarios.
types.OperationalProcess: Operational process: a sequence of operational activities serving one or more operational capabilities.
types.Part: Occurrence of a component within its parent; the component definition is designated by abstractType. Occurrences give the component hierarchy.
types.PartDeploymentLink: Deployment of one occurrence (deployedElement) on another (location), for example a behaviour on a physical node.
types.PhysicalArchitecture: Physical architecture layer: the chosen solution, with its hardware and software components.
types.PhysicalArchitectureRealization: Realization trace: the EPBS realizes the physical architecture.
types.PhysicalArtifactRealization: Realization trace: a configuration item (EPBS) realizes a physical element (component, port, link).
types.PhysicalComponent: Physical component: a node (hardware resource) or a behaviour (software, performed function), depending on its nature.
types.PhysicalComponentPkg: Package grouping the physical system, its components and its actors.
types.PhysicalLink: Physical link between two nodes (cable, bus, radio link…) supporting component exchanges.
types.PhysicalPath: Physical path: a continuous series of physical links through which exchanges pass.
types.PhysicalPathInvolvement: Physical link used by a physical path; nextInvolvements gives the next link.
types.PhysicalPort: Physical port of a node: connection point of physical links.
types.PortAllocation: Allocation of a function port to a component port.
types.PortRealization: Realization trace: a port realizes a port of the previous layer.
types.PropertyValueGroup: Named group of property values (for example a PVMT set).
types.PropertyValuePkg: Package grouping property values, groups and types.
types.RecCatalog: Root catalogue of reusable templates (REC) and their replicas (RPL).
types.Region: Region of a composite state or state machine; several regions evolve in parallel.
types.Role: Operational role: a consistent set of activities that one or more entities can take on.
types.RoleAllocation: Assignment of an operational role to an entity.
types.Scenario: Scenario: an ordered sequence of exchanges between lifelines, illustrating a capability.
types.ScenarioRealization: Realization trace: a scenario realizes a scenario of the previous layer.
types.SequenceLink: Link between two control nodes of a functional chain, with an optional condition.
types.State: State: a situation the system, an actor or a component is in because of circumstances (unlike a mode, which is chosen).
types.StateFragment: Period of a scenario lifeline during which a function runs or a mode / state is active.
types.StateMachine: State machine: the modes or states of an element (system, component, actor) and the transitions between them.
types.StateTransition: Transition from one mode or state to another, with optional trigger and guard.
types.StateTransitionRealization: Realization trace: a transition realizes a transition of the previous layer.
types.SystemAnalysis: System analysis layer: what the system must do for its users, seen as a black box.
types.SystemAnalysisRealization: Realization trace: the logical architecture realizes the system analysis.
types.SystemComponent: System analysis component: the system itself, or an external actor if actor='true'.
types.SystemComponentPkg: Package grouping the system and the actors.
types.SystemEngineering: Root of the Capella model: contains the ARCADIA engineering layers.
